patthana17.12:1.1: kusalaṃ parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
patthana17.12:2.1: kusalaṃ mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
patthana17.12:3.1: kusalaṃ appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
